lines.en: Zoe, did you hear? It was reported this morning that the Denver office would close at the end of the year.
lines.pt: Zoe, você soube? Foi divulgado hoje de manhã que o escritório de Denver fecharia no fim do ano.

lines.en: What? Who said that? The director told us last week that nobody should worry about a restructuring.
lines.pt: O quê? Quem disse isso? O diretor nos disse semana passada que ninguém deveria se preocupar com uma reestruturação.

lines.en: The spokesperson announced that the company was moving its operations to Texas. It is said that two hundred people will lose their jobs.
lines.pt: O porta-voz anunciou que a empresa estava transferindo as operações para o Texas. Diz-se que duzentas pessoas perderão o emprego.

lines.en: Two hundred! Did anyone ask whether there would be any redundancy payments, or whether we could relocate?
lines.pt: Duzentas! Alguém perguntou se haveria alguma indenização, ou se poderíamos nos transferir?

lines.en: Yes, a colleague asked how long the severance package would last. They replied that it was still being discussed.
lines.pt: Sim, um colega perguntou quanto tempo duraria o pacote de rescisão. Responderam que ainda estava sendo discutido.

lines.en: Typical. My manager told me that he had known nothing about it, but I do not believe him.
lines.pt: Típico. Minha gerente me disse que não sabia de nada, mas eu não acredito nela.

lines.en: It is believed that the decision was taken months ago. A friend in HR said they had been planning it since spring.
lines.pt: Acredita-se que a decisão foi tomada meses atrás. Uma amiga do RH disse que eles planejavam isso desde a primavera.

lines.en: So the rumours were true. Someone told me in March that the company was losing money, but I laughed.
lines.pt: Então os boatos eram verdadeiros. Alguém me disse em março que a empresa estava perdendo dinheiro, mas eu ri.

lines.en: Well, nobody is laughing now. The staff has been told to wait for an email and not to talk to the press.
lines.pt: Bem, ninguém está rindo agora. Disseram aos funcionários para esperar um e-mail e não falar com a imprensa.

lines.en: They asked us not to panic, but I want to know what they are planning to offer us.
lines.pt: Pediram para não entrarmos em pânico, mas quero saber o que planejam nos oferecer.

lines.en: Let us write to HR together. I will ask them to explain what will happen to people who refuse to move.
lines.pt: Vamos escrever para o RH juntas. Vou pedir que expliquem o que acontecerá com quem se recusar a mudar.

facts.big: It was reported that… / said that…
facts.label: Relato e passivo de relato
facts.sub: Notícia sem agente: It was reported that the office would close. Discurso indireto: She said that… / told me that… / asked whether…

facts.label: Passivo de relato
facts.sub: Estruturas como It was reported / It is said / It is believed that… dão a notícia sem citar quem falou. Ex.: It is said that two hundred people will lose their jobs. Típico de notícias e comunicados.

facts.label: will → would
facts.sub: No discurso indireto, os verbos costumam recuar: will vira would, is vira was, can vira could. Ex.: He said that the office would close. Se a notícia ainda vale, o recuo é opcional.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: It is said that… reports general opinion.
In reported speech, will often becomes would.

items.why: We say She told me that… or She said that…

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: It is said that… reports general opinion. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
In reported speech, will often becomes would. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “She said me that…”. → Falso (We say She told me that… or She said that…)
